name: Video Enhancer — Sharper Video & Up to 2× FPS
summary: Upgrade your videos: sharper detail, adaptive upscaling and built-in AI interpolation for up to 2× FPS. Free and processed locally.
description:
**Your videos. Sharper. Smoother.**

Give the videos you love a better picture and more fluid motion — with one free browser extension.

Make soft, lower-resolution video look crisper on a bigger screen. Bring extra clarity to gameplay, movie trailers, your favorite creators and the vertical clips in your feed. Then turn on built-in neural frame interpolation for up to twice the frame rate: **30 → 60 FPS. 60 → 120 FPS.**

**UPGRADE YOUR PICTURE**
- Adaptive upscaling with FSR1 and RAVU-lite.
- Adjustable RCAS sharpening for clearer edges and textures.
- Original/enhanced comparison so you can see the difference as you watch.

**GIVE MOTION MORE FLOW**
- Built-in IFRNet-S AI frame interpolation.
- New intermediate frames between the originals, for up to 2× output.
- No separate app, model download or complicated setup.

**YOUR BROWSER. YOUR GPU.**
Video processing stays on your device. No accounts, no video uploads, no telemetry and no subscription. Free to use, with source code on GitHub.

**START WATCHING BETTER**
Install Video Enhancer, open a video, and choose FSR1 or RAVU-lite in the popup. Adjust the sharpness to your taste. Enable frame interpolation when you want smoother motion.

Works with compatible HTML5 video players. Maximum frame rate depends on your video, GPU and browser; a compatible high-refresh display is needed to see 120 FPS.

[See interactive image comparisons and learn more](https://treeks12.github.io/video-enhancer/)
